title: Round comments
description: A person's comments on one round of a design, `rounds/<N>/comments.json` beside that round's screenshots. A direction of an exploration, a design in its `directions/` folder, has its own file in the exploration's round, `rounds/<N>/comments-<direction>.json`, named by the design file's name. The prototype viewer writes it (Download, or Copy the JSON) and lists the comments of earlier rounds beside the design. `aidd explore` pairs each comment with the round's screenshots, and `aidd validate` checks each file against this schema.

round.description: The round's number, the `<N>` of its `rounds/<N>/` folder.

items.description: The comments, in the order they were made.

id.description: The comment's id, `r<round>-<n>`, or `<direction>-r<round>-<n>` for a direction, such as `a-r1-2`, so two directions' ids never collide. A later round's `changes.json` names it in `answers`.

type.description: What the comment asks for: change, remove, or add something, or a question. A file without it reads as change.

screen.description: The screen the comment was made on, by its `data-screen` id.

state.description: The state the screen showed, by its `data-state` name.

testid.description: The `data-testid` of the element the comment is about.

index.description: Which of the visible elements that share the test id, counting from 0, when several do, such as one card of a list.

box.description: Where the element showed in the frame's view when the comment was made, in CSS pixels from the frame's top left.

comment.description: What the person said, in their words.

frame.description: The device frame the comment was made in, as the viewer's `frame=` key names it.

theme.description: The theme the comment was made in: light, dark, or system.

link.description: The viewer's deep link to the view the comment was made on.
